program_name: Bachelor in Games Design with Animation (Honours)

fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM86,780. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0004674/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: THREE (3) C’s at STPM level including in Pengajian Am / Kertas Am (General Studies / General Paper) and a Credit each in Bahasa Malaysia or Bahasa Melayu Silibus X / Bahasa Malaysia II at SPM/SPMV level; OR an MSU or a PTPL Diploma in a relevant field; OR an MSU Foundation Certificate; OR an equivalent qualification recognized by MSU Senate.
